body.purpose: Compact interface copy and control text.

label.purpose: Secondary metadata and compact control labels.

code.purpose: Source code, filenames, addresses, and machine readouts.

shadows.name: canvas-lift
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation of the pixel display from its stage.

shadows.name: dialog-overlay
shadows.purpose: Lift for the modal naming dialog.

shadows.name: reference-drawer
shadows.purpose: Separation for the fixed reference panel at intermediate widths.

motion.name: primary-hover
motion.purpose: Brief color transition on the primary action.

motion.name: status-reveal
motion.purpose: Small reveal when a status notice appears; omitted when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Run Button
components.description: The prominent action assembles the current source and runs the program.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 5px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--blue); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--blue); color: var(--paper); font: 600 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1737b7; border-color: #1737b7; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #1737b7; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet outlined or transparent action for supporting operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #29333d; font: 400 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e3e8ec; border-color: #9daab5; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #d7dfe5; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact text entry for names, addresses, search, and console input.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--muted); font: 400 11px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-width: 0; min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--paper); color: #29333d; font: 400 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Inspector Tabs
components.description: Switches between console and machine inspection views; the active view is marked by a bottom rule.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; overflow-x: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); } .ds-tabs button { flex: 0 0 auto; min-height: 39px; padding: 10px 15px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: 400 11px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-tabs button:hover { background: #e3e8ec; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected='true'] { border-bottom-color: var(--blue); background: var(--paper); color: #2448b7; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tabs span { margin-left: 4px; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px; background: #e3e8ee; color: #4d5c6e; font: 9px 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Workbench Panel Header
components.description: A lightly tinted, compact title bar shared by source, machine, and reference panels.
components.css: .ds-panel-bar { display: flex; min-height: 43px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); color: #29333d; } .ds-panel-bar strong { font: 600 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-panel-bar button { min-height: 27px; padding: 3px 7px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #29333d; font: 400 11px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-panel-bar button:hover { background: #e3e8ec; } .ds-panel-bar button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Machine Display Stage
components.description: Centers a pixelated live machine display on a quiet, cool surface.
components.css: .ds-display-stage { display: flex; min-height: 200px; min-width: 0; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: auto; padding: 18px; background-color: #dde3e7; background-image: radial-gradient(#aab7c3 0.6px, transparent .6px); background-size: 12px 12px; } .ds-display-stage canvas { display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; background: #001122; image-rendering: pixelated; object-fit: contain; box-shadow: 0 3px 12px #24364e24; }

narrative.overview:
The workbench is a calm, precise instrument for learning and building with Uxn. Light graphite framing and paper-like work surfaces keep attention on source and machine output; cobalt is reserved for the main action, links, focus, and clear active states. The visual language is compact and information-dense without making the tools compete with the program being edited.

The desk connects the real source editor to a live Varvara machine: source on the left, machine display on the right, and an inspection tray below. Project navigation stays at the edge, while assemble-and-run is the most prominent control. The interface favors clear borders, restrained states, and direct labels over ornamental chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Light graphite framing around warm-white work surfaces
Cobalt accents for action and interaction state
Source and live machine shown as paired instruments
Inspection views grouped in a persistent lower tray
Compact system typography with monospaced code and readouts

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep cobalt focused on actions, links, focus, and selected states; let neutral surfaces do the structural work.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Use tonal changes and quiet dividers to organize the desk; reserve shadows for elements that actually float above it.

dos: Do keep source and the live machine visible as the central paired work surfaces on wide screens.
Do make assemble-and-run the clearest action in the toolbar.
Do use cobalt for meaningful interaction states and keep supporting information muted.
Do distinguish code and machine values with the established monospaced stack.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and clear labels for controls.
Do use borders and tonal surfaces to make dense work areas easy to scan.
donts: Don't replace the light graphite-and-paper foundation with a dark or highly saturated overall palette.
Don't introduce competing accent colors for ordinary controls or selected states.
Don't use decorative imagery, gradients, or motion that competes with source or machine output.
Don't turn the workbench panels into floating cards with heavy shadows or pill-shaped controls.
